mapper.select:
select
ftp.FINPROD_ID ||ftp.BRANCH || ptlHold.PORTFOLIO_ID ||ptlHold.INV_AIM id, ftp.FINPROD_ID, ftp.BRANCH, ftp.CCY, ftp.MDATE, ftp.BRANCH_TYPE, fpt.TYPE_8, fcp.CASH_TYPE, fcp.PAY_DATE, fcpmid.CASH_TYPE CASH_TYPE_MID, fcpmid.MDATE MDATE_MID, fcpmid.PAY_DATE PAY_DATE_MID, fcpmid.IS_PAY_INT IS_PAY_INT_MID, ptlHold.INV_AIM, ptlHold.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptlHold.SEC_ACCT_ID, ptlHold.AMOUNT,
nvl(( select sum(RECE_AMT) RECE_AMT from PTL_SEC_RECEIVABLES psr where ftp.FINPROD_ID = psr.FINPROD_ID and ptlHold.PORTFOLIO_ID = psr.PORTFOLIO_ID
and (ptlHold.CHl_ID =psr.sec_acct_id or (substr(ptlHold.CHl_ID,1,3)!='F28' and psr.sec_acct_id ='999999'))/*ADD BY KYF 20200415 既有直投又有通道的情况*/
and ftp.BRANCH = psr.BRANCH and psr.INV_AIM = ptlHold.INV_AIM and psr.CDATE = #{PRE_PLATE_DATE} ),0) as RECE_AMT, fp.ACTMDATE,
nvl(( select sum(SHARE_AMT) SHARE_AMT from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv where ftp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and ptlHold.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID
and (ptlHold.CHl_ID=psv.sec_acct_id or (substr(ptlHold.CHl_ID,1,3)!='F28' and psv.sec_acct_id ='999999'))
and psv.INV_AIM = ptlHold.INV_AIM and psv.CDATE = nvl(fcpmid.MDATE,fcp.MDATE) -1
),0) as SHARE_AMT
from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp
left join (
select t.CDATE, t.INV_AIM, t.CHl_ID, t.FINPROD_ID, t.PORTFOLIO_ID, t.SEC_ACCT_ID, SUM(t.AMOUNT) AMOUNT from ( select psp.CDATE, psp.INV_AIM, decode(#{chlFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'01',decode(FP.FINPROD_TYPE2,'F18','999999','F27','999999','F17','999999',psp.SEC_ACCT_ID),psp.SEC_ACCT_ID) CHl_ID, psp.FINPROD_ID, psp.PORTFOLIO_ID, psp.SEC_ACCT_ID, psp.AMOUNT from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp left join fin_product FP on PSP.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID where psp.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_SJ} and psp.BRANCH = #{BRANCH} )t GROUP BY t.CDATE, t.INV_AIM, t.CHl_ID, t.FINPROD_ID, t.PORTFOLIO_ID, t.SEC_ACCT_ID
) ptlHold on ptlHold.CDATE = ftp.MDATE -1 and ptlHold.FINPROD_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID and fpt.BRANCH = #{BRANCH}
left join FIN_CASH_INFO pci on pci.FINPROD_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID and pci.BRANCH = #{BRANCH} and pci.CASH_TYPE_2 = decode(ftp.BRANCH_TYPE,#{BRANCH_TYPE_YSBJ},#{CASH_TYPE_2_BJ},#{CASH_TYPE_2_LX})
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp on fcp.CASH_ID = pci.CASH_ID and fcp.MDATE = ftp.MDATE
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO fcimid on fcimid.FINPROD_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID and fcimid.BRANCH = #{BRANCH} and fcimid.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_BJ}
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN fcpmid on fcpmid.CASH_ID = fcimid.CASH_ID and fcpmid.MDATE = ftp.MDATE
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID
where
(greatest(fcp.MDATE,fcp.PAY_DATE) = #{PRE_PLATE_DATE} OR greatest(fcpmid.MDATE,fcpmid.PAY_DATE) = #{PRE_PLATE_DATE})
null) OR ptlHold.PORTFOLIO_ID in (
#{item}
AND fpt.TYPE_8 in (#{PINAN_ASSET_TYPE_ZQ},#{PINAN_ASSET_TYPE_CK},#{PINAN_ASSET_TYPE_JHLLLX},#{PINAN_ASSET_TYPE_XML})
and ptlHold.sec_acct_id IN (select FINPROD_ID from fin_product t where t.finprod_type2 = 'F28')
and ptlHold.sec_acct_id NOT IN (select FINPROD_ID from fin_product t where t.finprod_type2 = 'F28')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tfpdt LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tdta on tfpdt.TRADE_ID = tdta.TRADE_ID where tdta.MP_FINPROD_ID is null and tfpdt.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_CS} and tfpdt.IS_CANCEL = #{YON_N}
AND tfpdt.IS_CLEAN = #{YON_Y} AND tfpdt.PS in(#{PS_HBDZ},#{PS_SXDZ}) AND tfpdt.FINPROD_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID AND tfpdt.branch = ftp.BRANCH and tfpdt.trade_date < #{PLATE_DATE} and (nvl(nvl(tfpdt.CHL_ID,tfpdt.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID),'999999') = ptlHold.SEC_ACCT_ID ) )
